text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
(Hello, I'm Etsuko Otonashi! As a reporter
for Monthly Twinkle,
I cover the races of the Umamusume I love
with an ever-thrilled heart!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
(I came to Tracen Academy today looking
for story ideas
and brainstorming the layout for the
upcoming special issue, but...——)

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Is someone sleeping...—
...Gasp! This mane-like hair is...!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Halt.
You are being insolent...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...To dare disturb Our slumber.
Who goes there?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"(The 'Tyrant' Orfevre-san—bearing the
presence befitting a king,
a high-profile Umamusume showing dazzling
prominence in the racing world...!)"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"......Ho.
—Woman. Thou art saying thou wishest to
interview Us?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Huh! A-Ah, yes! Absolutelyyyy!
Talk about a stroke of good luck—or should
I say, Umamusume falling from the sky...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"............ Very well.
I shall grant thee permission to interview
Us. Show Us thy loyalty."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—I am the one. The king who rules this
era.
Etch the honor of living in my reign with
your pen.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"............!! What incredible
intensity...!
Yes! I would be delighted to write it!"
*sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It's always... him. Not just because he's
flashy,
he's got real skill to back it up... so of
course he gets the spotlight, but still—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...Hm? That reporter's running
somewhere...
...Interviewing someone else? Then, I
should also...!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm, a special feature edition.
And you're saying you'd like to interview
me for it?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"(The 'Gentle Donna' Gentildonna-san—she,
too, is a fiercely watched Umamusume
radiating an aura of overwhelming
power...!)"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
We just interviewed Orfevre-san,
so we would absolutely love to hear your
story as well!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose so. If you're going to
write about Orfe-san...
there ought to be an article about me, who
is 'stronger' than her.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Strength is the proof of an absolute
victor.
Those possessing overwhelming power shall
inevitably triumph and become justice
itself."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
――In short, "strength." That is the sole
prerequisite for a victor.
Which is precisely why I undergo this
daily training...――

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: U-Um... Gentile-san...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ...Oh dear.
I've done it again.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Do you not have any harder iron balls?
This provides no strength training
whatsoever.
*Sigh*... Let us finish the interview
first. I shall go change.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—Ngh, ngghhhhh...!
...Haaah!! Dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I guess I'm still not—... Wait!
There are no reporters around again! —Next
time, I'm definitely speaking up...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
――...Gentil.
Why do you appear before me?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, please don't be so afraid.
They just said they want to take a
two-shot photo for the feature article.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind, you know? Ah, but...
standing next to me might only make you
look worse by comparison.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"......Nonsense.
Woman. If this one is here, We shall
withdraw."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
――In that case,
would you be willing to interview us
instead?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Getting interviewed sounds suuuper fun♪
Please, pretty please~♡

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
(The Verxina and Vivlos sisters...!
And with Cheval Grand included, they're
the ultra-talked-about ultimate trio of
sisters!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I have no objections.
No matter who it is, they will still be
behind me—in "second place."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Second place. Yes, that's right,
perhaps that's where I am now.
You are noble, and undeniably strong...
All I ever see is your back.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
However, the only one destined to defeat
you—is none other than myself.
For I am the Umamusume meant to stand at
the "pinnacle"!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"By the time the article is published, the
victor will have been replaced.
Will you still be able to remain so
composed then...? I look forward to seeing
that."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek♡ As expected of my big sis, super
duper cool♪
Hey, hey, reporter! Why don't we just
change the special feature altogether?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I want Cheval-chi to be featured in an
article with us too, you know?
Give it a sparkly cover, and it'll sell
like crazy as a super-celeb exclusive♡"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Celebrityyy?
Feed that crap to Jordan for all I care!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Mayday, mayday, do you copy, Buddy 'n'
Soul?
It's Golshi-chan's new face! Feast your
eyes on this☆

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"Gold Ship-san!?
Where on earth did you come from...!?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"New World! This is Golshi-chan ver564,
over?
I don't care if you're a tyrant, a noble
lady, or emo sisters or whatever—"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Trends always start with me!
Peace-peeeace!
Ganbappe! Ei-ei-mun!
Do-do-do-do-do-suuun... *wheeze*..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Everyone's so intense after all.
...I'm just kindaâ
...No, instead of getting down, first I
gotta...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
――...Gh... Excuse me! Mr. Reporter!
Could you... interview me too!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Win Variation-san!?
O-Of course I'm grateful for the offer,
but...?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I might not stand out as much as everyone
else right now, but...
Someday, I swear I'll shine brighter than
anyone... and become the star!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Please, watch over me. Watch my
efforts... and my future!
...I would love to join the filming!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
――Eh, a pose...? ...W-Whoa, amazing...!?
I-I'll try too... hrgh...! ...W-Wait, does
this look off...!?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"...I've decided! The next special feature
will be... 'Sparkling Individuality!
The Dawn of a New Era'—Now, let's keep the
interviews going!!"
